header:
University of Edinburgh and AGQ CDT (with
Glasgow and Heriot-Watt)
United Kingdom · Algebra, Geometry and Topology PhD; joint Algebra, Geometry and Mathematical Physics PhD; optional funded
pre-year MSc
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Programme-specific AGQ workflow differs materially from general Edinburgh/Glasgow instructions: two
application forms and manually arranged AGQ references.
• 18 December is the earliest of conflicting official 2027 application dates; do not assume January protects AGQ
funding.
• Fully funded pre-year MSc is a particularly relevant bachelor’s-entry path, but international availability and
progression terms need confirmation.
• EDCS access can require ten working days and an Edinburgh application record even though AGQ initially
collects data through Glasgow.
• Faculty list covers principal relevant Edinburgh contacts and four especially relevant Glasgow contacts plus
joint Kim; broader AGQ mathematical physics, topology and algebra faculty remain on the supervisor directory.
Beentjes explicitly not recruiting; postdocs and retired faculty not presented as regular available advisers.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
AGQ accepts applicants with or expecting at least UK 2:1-equivalent bachelor’s; an MSc is not universally
required. Applicants may request the fully funded MSc pre-year pathway. Edinburgh’s general direct PhD rule is
first-class bachelor’s, or 2:1 plus master’s; do not conflate this with the AGQ threshold. UChicago international
graduates may apply subject to equivalence, preparation and funding selection; US F-1 creates no UK status
entitlement. [s1] [s3]
Before submission [Standing rule]
AGQ requires BOTH its pre-application form and the Glasgow application portal, including for Edinburgh-aligned
degrees. Choose admissions panel and three topic keywords; supervisor preferences optional. Ask two
academics to send letters through AGQ’s separate reference link. Follow the programme-specific Glasgow
placeholder instructions in portal_public_instructions. [s1]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Prior supervisor commitment is not required; Edinburgh encourages discussion and AGQ supervisor
preferences are optional. Use the faculty list below and verify current affiliation/2027 capacity. Nick Sheridan
explicitly says he is accepting students through AGQ; Antony Maciocia’s university profile welcomes
supervision enquiries. [s1] [s3] [s9] [s10]
Portal workflow [2027 confirmed]
Glasgow form: proposed start 1 September 2027; funding University of Glasgow Scholarship, details N/A,
confirmed No; supervisor Tara Brendle and contacted No are administrative placeholders, not actual choice.
Confidential references: use Not applicable names/capacity with agq-references@glasgow.ac.uk and
agq-cdt@glasgow.ac.uk, not writers’ contacts. Put panel name in short research field; leave proposal blank.
Actual optional supervisor choices belong in pre-form. Follow live programme instructions carefully. [s1]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Conflict]
AGQ page explicitly gives 18 December 2026 for both forms/full consideration, with later rolling consideration
only if possible; clock/timezone not stated. Edinburgh’s 2027 AGQ catalogue says 19 December 2026, while
general Mathematics says 18 January 2027. Use 18 December as the prudent target and obtain written
clarification rather than assuming January applies to AGQ/AGT. [s1] [s4] [s5]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
AGQ full consideration follows the December application target. General Edinburgh School/EPSRC full
consideration: 18 January 2027 (no clock given). EDCS and Mathematics CSC: 1 February 2027, 23:59
(timezone not stated); separate applications. Martingale closed 18 October 2026, 23:59. [s1] [s4]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
AGQ: 8 January 2027, no published clock/timezone. General Edinburgh route requires complete references for
decision, but no independent 2027 mathematics deadline or scholarship grace period located. Do not transfer
Edinburgh’s generic automated timing to AGQ’s manual reference route. [s1] [s3] [s7]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
AGQ can review with missing evidence; any offer remains conditional on supplying it. No universal separate
score cutoff published. Edinburgh CSC applicants must prove English eligibility when applying by its
scholarship deadline. [s1] [s4]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
Aim to complete AGQ evidence by 18 December 2026; later documents accepted without guaranteed full
consideration, and missing-evidence offers are conditional. Programme-specific final degree/English condition
dates and separate EDCS document cutoff unverified. [s1] [s4]

No universal commitment date found. AGQ interviews begin February, offers expected from March for several
months, first round aims to finish June. If a competing offer has a deadline, applicant may request timely
update at admissions@agq-cdt.org. Individual offer governs acceptance. [s1]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Conflict]
AGQ lists IELTS 6.5 overall/6.0 each, TOEFL iBT 92/20 each, PTE 68/63 each, Cambridge 176/169 each; tests
within two years at application. Edinburgh’s older general mathematics page instead has PTE 61/56 and
measures test age at programme start. The degree route below is preferable if applicable; confirm current
scale rules for newly reformatted TOEFL tests rather than extrapolating old totals. [s1] [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
AGQ accepts undergraduate/master’s degrees taught and assessed in English in a UKVI
majority-English-speaking country, which includes a completed UChicago degree by inference. Edinburgh
general page limits degree age to 3.5 years at programme start; Glasgow FAQ adds final two years in the
country within six years. Confirm receiving university’s documentation and timing rather than requesting an
unconditional blanket waiver. [s1] [s3] [s11]

GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
No GRE requirement or recommendation found in AGQ or Edinburgh mathematics lists. Public sources do not
explicitly say scores are ignored or prohibited; optional-upload policy remains unverified. [s1] [s3]

sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two academic letters for AGQ and Edinburgh mathematics. This is stricter than generic Glasgow wording
permitting one professional letter; use two academic writers under programme-specific instructions. [s1] [s3]
[s12]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
AGQ/School funding is considered with admission; no additional ordinary scholarship referee identified. EDCS
separate-letter requirement and questions are not publicly established here. CSC requires its later
employer-reference form and separate selection process if eligible; see funding_other_sources. [s1] [s4]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
AGQ: applicant personally asks writers to submit via AGQ link; do not expect invitations when entering
pre-application details. Glasgow portal must use the prescribed placeholder contacts if letters are confidential,
to prevent irrelevant automated requests. Generic Edinburgh requests follow submission and account creation;
that is a different workflow. [s1] [s7]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
AGQ’s separate writer upload is not described as waiting for final portal submission; manually arrange it. For an
independently authorised Edinburgh EUCLID route, automatic requests follow submission/UUN assignment,
which may take up to seven days. [s1] [s7]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
AGQ writer upload displays submission confirmation and emails receipt to the writer; no need for writer to ask
staff separately. Applicant-side receipt tracking is not explicitly documented. Generic Edinburgh Applicant Hub
tracks reference status. [s2] [s7]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
No AGQ public update/replace/reuse rule found. Ask admissions@agq-cdt.org before a writer resubmits.
Reference file naming: for-[Student surname]-from-[Referee surname].pdf; .doc or .txt also accepted if named
consistently. Do not assume generic Glasgow uploaded letters automatically reach AGQ. [s2]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
AGQ requires uploaded PDF CV describing academic/professional preparation for mathematics graduate study;
no public page limit/font/size established. Edinburgh ordinary mathematics asks for an up-to-date CV in the
proposal slot instead of a proposal. [s1] [s3]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
AGQ pre-form requires a motivation response, maximum 1,000 characters and described as half a page;
faithful paraphrase: why pursue mathematics graduate study. Enter form text. If a separate Edinburgh EUCLID
application is requested, its general personal statement limit is 3,500 characters (about 500 words):
preparation, relevant experience, programme/Edinburgh motivation and career aims. These are distinct routes,
not automatically cumulative essays. [s1] [s8]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No separate background/diversity essay identified for AGQ. Its demographic form data is withheld from
assessment panels/interviews. EDCS exact personal-statement questions must be obtained in the Mathematics
scholarship portal; other Schools publish different prompts, so they are not imported here. [s1] [s4]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
AGQ asks panel preference plus three interest keywords; optional supervisors are withheld from initial panels
but used for interview arrangements. Glasgow research short field should contain the admissions-panel name,
not a 250-character project proposal. [s1]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
AGQ: explicitly unnecessary; leave Glasgow proposal section blank. Edinburgh Mathematics likewise explicitly
does not require a proposal and instead requests CV in that slot. Generic university proposal prompts do not
override these instructions. [s1] [s3]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
AGQ pre-form: maximum 1,000-character/half-page account of academic work you are proud of and why;
optional PDF attachment of that work. No required full thesis or publication manuscript. Attachment page/size
limits not published. [s1]
Publications list [Unresolved]
No separate mandatory publication list found; CV may contain relevant scholarship. AGQ’s optional
academic-work PDF is the specifically authorised sample channel. Additional full-paper upload/link rules
unverified. [s1] [s3]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate course list or syllabi document required in AGQ/Mathematics public instructions. Provide the
marked transcript; permission for extra course-description uploads and any template/length are unverified. [s1]
[s3]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
AGQ pre-year MSc scholarship consideration is a checkbox/question on pre-form, withheld from PhD panels; no
separate essay specified. EDCS needs a MyEd/EUCLID scholarship application; Mathematics exact
prompt/length and additional-reference questions not public in sources reviewed. CSC requires department
application form then CSC application/employer-reference form. [s1] [s4]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Separate Edinburgh central form, if needed, has relevant knowledge/training section for extra experience;
exact limit not established. Its guidance requires applicant’s own truthful statement and warns
outsourced/AI-written statements may be treated as fraud. No additional AGQ essay is published beyond the
two short answers above. [s1] [s8]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
AGQ covers full tuition and tax-free annual UKRI-linked stipend; page still quotes £20,780 for 2025/26, not
2027. Edinburgh School/EPSRC page quotes £21,805 for 2026/27, also not 2027. Neither establishes exact
2027/28 stipend. EDCS covers fees plus stipend; Mathematics cash amount not yet specified. AGQ MSc
pre-year likewise covers fees and stipend; amount unverified. Visa/IHS, payment schedule and additional travel
allowance not established. [s1] [s4]
Years of support [2027 confirmed]
Fully funded Edinburgh PhD and AGQ support cover four years, including writing-up. EDCS Mathematics
2027/28 also four years. AGQ may add a fully funded MSc pre-year; formal progression and total support terms
should be confirmed in offer. [s1] [s4]
International eligibility [2027 confirmed]
Edinburgh School/EPSRC states awards open to all applicants with full fees and stipend; EDCS explicitly open to
UK and overseas candidates. AGQ catalogue says eligibility is assessed under funder rules; precise 2027
international allocation/cap and MSc pre-year international availability need confirmation, not assumed from
US residence. [s4] [s5]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Funding is competitive and linked to programme/funder eligibility; no universal entitlement follows admission.
AGQ assigns primary institution by principal supervisor; degree is jointly awarded and applications are
considered across hosts, so several supervisor/host offers may result. Check conditions of any MSc-to-PhD
progression and overseas fee coverage in the actual award. [s1] [s5]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
AGQ and Edinburgh School/EPSRC consideration automatic with appropriate admission application. EDCS
separate MyEd application needs an Edinburgh course application first; access may take ten working days.
Because AGQ collects applications at Glasgow, ask Edinburgh how to create the linked EUCLID record in time
rather than assuming Glasgow login grants scholarship access. [s1] [s4]
Other funding routes [2027 confirmed]
EDCS and CSC both have the February deadline above. Mathematics CSC advertises one award: PRC
citizen/permanent resident, not working abroad, overseas students may apply, not already in PhD,
return-to-China obligation; requires English proof at application and predicted first-class equivalent from a
Chinese university, which may exclude a UChicago-only degree. Citizenship is unknown. Martingale principally
addresses eligible UK students facing financial barriers and its deadline passed. [s4]
Application fee [Standing rule]
Edinburgh 2027 AGQ catalogue says no application fee; Glasgow FAQ likewise says postgraduate applications
are free. [s5] [s11]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
No waiver needed for the documented fee-free AGQ application. No separate EDCS/AGQ application charge
identified. [s5] [s11]

Pay attention to
• Programme-specific AGQ workflow differs materially from general Edinburgh/Glasgow instructions: two
application forms and manually arranged AGQ references.
• 18 December is the earliest of conflicting official 2027 application dates; do not assume January protects AGQ
funding.
• Fully funded pre-year MSc is a particularly relevant bachelor’s-entry path, but international availability and
progression terms need confirmation.
• EDCS access can require ten working days and an Edinburgh application record even though AGQ initially
collects data through Glasgow.
• Faculty list covers principal relevant Edinburgh contacts and four especially relevant Glasgow contacts plus
joint Kim; broader AGQ mathematical physics, topology and algebra faculty remain on the supervisor directory.
Beentjes explicitly not recruiting; postdocs and retired faculty not presented as regular available advisers.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
AGQ accepts applicants with or expecting at least UK 2:1-equivalent bachelor’s; an MSc is not universally
required. Applicants may request the fully funded MSc pre-year pathway. Edinburgh’s general direct PhD rule is
first-class bachelor’s, or 2:1 plus master’s; do not conflate this with the AGQ threshold. UChicago international
graduates may apply subject to equivalence, preparation and funding selection; US F-1 creates no UK status
entitlement. [s1] [s3]
Before submission [Standing rule]
AGQ requires BOTH its pre-application form and the Glasgow application portal, including for Edinburgh-aligned
degrees. Choose admissions panel and three topic keywords; supervisor preferences optional. Ask two
academics to send letters through AGQ’s separate reference link. Follow the programme-specific Glasgow
placeholder instructions in portal_public_instructions. [s1]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Prior supervisor commitment is not required; Edinburgh encourages discussion and AGQ supervisor
preferences are optional. Use the faculty list below and verify current affiliation/2027 capacity. Nick Sheridan
explicitly says he is accepting students through AGQ; Antony Maciocia’s university profile welcomes
supervision enquiries. [s1] [s3] [s9] [s10]
Portal workflow [2027 confirmed]
Glasgow form: proposed start 1 September 2027; funding University of Glasgow Scholarship, details N/A,
confirmed No; supervisor Tara Brendle and contacted No are administrative placeholders, not actual choice.
Confidential references: use Not applicable names/capacity with agq-references@glasgow.ac.uk and
agq-cdt@glasgow.ac.uk, not writers’ contacts. Put panel name in short research field; leave proposal blank.
Actual optional supervisor choices belong in pre-form. Follow live programme instructions carefully. [s1]

catalogue/search still has conflicting dates/open-status text; AGT indexed record is 2026. AGQ

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Conflict]
AGQ page explicitly gives 18 December 2026 for both forms/full consideration, with later rolling consideration
only if possible; clock/timezone not stated. Edinburgh’s 2027 AGQ catalogue says 19 December 2026, while
general Mathematics says 18 January 2027. Use 18 December as the prudent target and obtain written
clarification rather than assuming January applies to AGQ/AGT. [s1] [s4] [s5]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
AGQ full consideration follows the December application target. General Edinburgh School/EPSRC full
consideration: 18 January 2027 (no clock given). EDCS and Mathematics CSC: 1 February 2027, 23:59
(timezone not stated); separate applications. Martingale closed 18 October 2026, 23:59. [s1] [s4]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
AGQ: 8 January 2027, no published clock/timezone. General Edinburgh route requires complete references for
decision, but no independent 2027 mathematics deadline or scholarship grace period located. Do not transfer
Edinburgh’s generic automated timing to AGQ’s manual reference route. [s1] [s3] [s7]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
AGQ can review with missing evidence; any offer remains conditional on supplying it. No universal separate
score cutoff published. Edinburgh CSC applicants must prove English eligibility when applying by its
scholarship deadline. [s1] [s4]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
Aim to complete AGQ evidence by 18 December 2026; later documents accepted without guaranteed full
consideration, and missing-evidence offers are conditional. Programme-specific final degree/English condition
dates and separate EDCS document cutoff unverified. [s1] [s4]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal commitment date found. AGQ interviews begin February, offers expected from March for several
months, first round aims to finish June. If a competing offer has a deadline, applicant may request timely
update at admissions@agq-cdt.org. Individual offer governs acceptance. [s1]
English and GRE
English requirement [Conflict]
AGQ lists IELTS 6.5 overall/6.0 each, TOEFL iBT 92/20 each, PTE 68/63 each, Cambridge 176/169 each; tests
within two years at application. Edinburgh’s older general mathematics page instead has PTE 61/56 and
measures test age at programme start. The degree route below is preferable if applicable; confirm current
scale rules for newly reformatted TOEFL tests rather than extrapolating old totals. [s1] [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
AGQ accepts undergraduate/master’s degrees taught and assessed in English in a UKVI
majority-English-speaking country, which includes a completed UChicago degree by inference. Edinburgh
general page limits degree age to 3.5 years at programme start; Glasgow FAQ adds final two years in the
country within six years. Confirm receiving university’s documentation and timing rather than requesting an
unconditional blanket waiver. [s1] [s3] [s11]

General Edinburgh requires undergraduate and any master’s interim/final transcripts and certificates for
degrees already awarded; no certificate is required for the current uncompleted degree. Glasgow ordinarily
requests colour scans of original records. [s1] [s3] [s12]

Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two academic letters for AGQ and Edinburgh mathematics. This is stricter than generic Glasgow wording
permitting one professional letter; use two academic writers under programme-specific instructions. [s1] [s3]
[s12]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
AGQ/School funding is considered with admission; no additional ordinary scholarship referee identified. EDCS
separate-letter requirement and questions are not publicly established here. CSC requires its later
employer-reference form and separate selection process if eligible; see funding_other_sources. [s1] [s4]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
AGQ: applicant personally asks writers to submit via AGQ link; do not expect invitations when entering
pre-application details. Glasgow portal must use the prescribed placeholder contacts if letters are confidential,
to prevent irrelevant automated requests. Generic Edinburgh requests follow submission and account creation;
that is a different workflow. [s1] [s7]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
AGQ’s separate writer upload is not described as waiting for final portal submission; manually arrange it. For an
independently authorised Edinburgh EUCLID route, automatic requests follow submission/UUN assignment,
which may take up to seven days. [s1] [s7]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
AGQ writer upload displays submission confirmation and emails receipt to the writer; no need for writer to ask
staff separately. Applicant-side receipt tracking is not explicitly documented. Generic Edinburgh Applicant Hub
tracks reference status. [s2] [s7]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
No AGQ public update/replace/reuse rule found. Ask admissions@agq-cdt.org before a writer resubmits.
Reference file naming: for-[Student surname]-from-[Referee surname].pdf; .doc or .txt also accepted if named
consistently. Do not assume generic Glasgow uploaded letters automatically reach AGQ. [s2]

Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
AGQ requires uploaded PDF CV describing academic/professional preparation for mathematics graduate study;
no public page limit/font/size established. Edinburgh ordinary mathematics asks for an up-to-date CV in the
proposal slot instead of a proposal. [s1] [s3]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
AGQ pre-form requires a motivation response, maximum 1,000 characters and described as half a page;
faithful paraphrase: why pursue mathematics graduate study. Enter form text. If a separate Edinburgh EUCLID
application is requested, its general personal statement limit is 3,500 characters (about 500 words):
preparation, relevant experience, programme/Edinburgh motivation and career aims. These are distinct routes,
not automatically cumulative essays. [s1] [s8]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No separate background/diversity essay identified for AGQ. Its demographic form data is withheld from
assessment panels/interviews. EDCS exact personal-statement questions must be obtained in the Mathematics
scholarship portal; other Schools publish different prompts, so they are not imported here. [s1] [s4]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
AGQ asks panel preference plus three interest keywords; optional supervisors are withheld from initial panels
but used for interview arrangements. Glasgow research short field should contain the admissions-panel name,
not a 250-character project proposal. [s1]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
AGQ: explicitly unnecessary; leave Glasgow proposal section blank. Edinburgh Mathematics likewise explicitly
does not require a proposal and instead requests CV in that slot. Generic university proposal prompts do not
override these instructions. [s1] [s3]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
AGQ pre-form: maximum 1,000-character/half-page account of academic work you are proud of and why;
optional PDF attachment of that work. No required full thesis or publication manuscript. Attachment page/size
limits not published. [s1]
Publications list [Unresolved]
No separate mandatory publication list found; CV may contain relevant scholarship. AGQ’s optional
academic-work PDF is the specifically authorised sample channel. Additional full-paper upload/link rules
unverified. [s1] [s3]

No separate course list or syllabi document required in AGQ/Mathematics public instructions. Provide the
marked transcript; permission for extra course-description uploads and any template/length are unverified. [s1]
[s3]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
AGQ pre-year MSc scholarship consideration is a checkbox/question on pre-form, withheld from PhD panels; no
separate essay specified. EDCS needs a MyEd/EUCLID scholarship application; Mathematics exact
prompt/length and additional-reference questions not public in sources reviewed. CSC requires department
application form then CSC application/employer-reference form. [s1] [s4]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Separate Edinburgh central form, if needed, has relevant knowledge/training section for extra experience;
exact limit not established. Its guidance requires applicant’s own truthful statement and warns
outsourced/AI-written statements may be treated as fraud. No additional AGQ essay is published beyond the
two short answers above. [s1] [s8]

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
AGQ covers full tuition and tax-free annual UKRI-linked stipend; page still quotes £20,780 for 2025/26, not
2027. Edinburgh School/EPSRC page quotes £21,805 for 2026/27, also not 2027. Neither establishes exact
2027/28 stipend. EDCS covers fees plus stipend; Mathematics cash amount not yet specified. AGQ MSc
pre-year likewise covers fees and stipend; amount unverified. Visa/IHS, payment schedule and additional travel
allowance not established. [s1] [s4]
Years of support [2027 confirmed]
Fully funded Edinburgh PhD and AGQ support cover four years, including writing-up. EDCS Mathematics
2027/28 also four years. AGQ may add a fully funded MSc pre-year; formal progression and total support terms
should be confirmed in offer. [s1] [s4]
International eligibility [2027 confirmed]
Edinburgh School/EPSRC states awards open to all applicants with full fees and stipend; EDCS explicitly open to
UK and overseas candidates. AGQ catalogue says eligibility is assessed under funder rules; precise 2027
international allocation/cap and MSc pre-year international availability need confirmation, not assumed from
US residence. [s4] [s5]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Funding is competitive and linked to programme/funder eligibility; no universal entitlement follows admission.
AGQ assigns primary institution by principal supervisor; degree is jointly awarded and applications are
considered across hosts, so several supervisor/host offers may result. Check conditions of any MSc-to-PhD
progression and overseas fee coverage in the actual award. [s1] [s5]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
AGQ and Edinburgh School/EPSRC consideration automatic with appropriate admission application. EDCS
separate MyEd application needs an Edinburgh course application first; access may take ten working days.
Because AGQ collects applications at Glasgow, ask Edinburgh how to create the linked EUCLID record in time
rather than assuming Glasgow login grants scholarship access. [s1] [s4]
Other funding routes [2027 confirmed]
EDCS and CSC both have the February deadline above. Mathematics CSC advertises one award: PRC
citizen/permanent resident, not working abroad, overseas students may apply, not already in PhD,
return-to-China obligation; requires English proof at application and predicted first-class equivalent from a
Chinese university, which may exclude a UChicago-only degree. Citizenship is unknown. Martingale principally
addresses eligible UK students facing financial barriers and its deadline passed. [s4]
Application fee [Standing rule]
Edinburgh 2027 AGQ catalogue says no application fee; Glasgow FAQ likewise says postgraduate applications
are free. [s5] [s11]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
No waiver needed for the documented fee-free AGQ application. No separate EDCS/AGQ application charge
identified. [s5] [s11]
